_meta.about: Semantic SFX map for "What If Real Life Had a SETTINGS MENU?". load with audio/lib.py: lib.load_sfx(name, variant).
_meta.gain_rule: gain_db brings the clip to ref_lufs: one-shots by their loudest 200 ms window (lufs_200), loops/beds by integrated loudness (lufs_i); then capped so true peak after gain <= peak_ceiling_dbtp (peak_limited=true). The mixer sets the final level relative to this common reference (e.g. key SFX about -3..-6 dB, beds -12..-20 dB).
_meta.times: t0/t1 are seconds in the source file (library.json path). dur_ms = clip length. onset_ms = first 5 ms frame within 20 dB of the clip peak (the attack). peak_ms = loudest 5 ms frame. sync_ms = the frame to put on the picture event (onset for hits; peak for whooshes, risers and swells). tail_ms = peak to the last frame above peak-50 dB.
_meta.variants: lib.load_sfx(name, i) takes i modulo len(variants), so cycling i gives one-for-one different sounds for repeats.
_meta.hook_flag: hook=true marks names needed by the 60-s hook (S00 + S01-L001).
